name: 3xx-7xx Support
body:
Great news, everyone! We now have complete support for all 7.xx firmware versions—covering everything from 3.00 up to 7.61!

A huge shoutout to @sleirsgoevy for creating this project! We also couldn’t have started without the help of @zecoxao and keys friend, so a massive thanks to them. Big appreciation as well to @buzzer-re , @BestPig , @idlesauce , @Al-Azif  and everyone else who contributed—we truly value all your support!
